name: Ashita Sekai ga Owaru Yoru ni
original_name: 明日世界が終わる夜に
source:
When hero Shinpei goes to school on Friday a strange rumor of the end of the world the next day spreads. Everyone gets crazy and the school shuts down preventing anyone leaving. Shinpei does not believe in that rumor, but he has to await for the morning in this agitated atmosphere.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
当英雄新平周五去上学时，第二天世界末日的奇怪谣言就流传开来。每个人都变得疯狂，学校关闭，阻止任何人离开。新平并不相信这个传闻，但他必须在这种焦躁的气氛中等待早晨的到来。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
